source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT CAST( COUNT( DISTINCT `t2`.`id` ) AS DOUBLE ) / COUNT( DISTINCT `t1`.`id` ) FROM `votes` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `posts` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`userid` = `t2`.`owneruserid` WHERE `t1`.`userid` = 24
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT CAST( COUNT( DISTINCT "t2"."id" ) AS FLOAT8 ) / COUNT(DISTINCT "t1"."id") FROM "votes" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "t2" ON "t1"."userid" = "t2"."owneruserid" WHERE "t1"."userid" = 24
